audience: project managers who track active projects and open tasks in Project Insight

useCases.title: See which projects are in progress
useCases.text: List the active projects, then read one project by id.

useCases.title: Review the tasks of one project
useCases.text: List the tasks of one project, with the default properties or the model properties you select.

useCases.title: Find tasks and projects by keyword
useCases.text: Search tasks by keyword across active projects, and search projects by text, customer or project number.

useCases.title: Start a new project in a container
useCases.text: Search for the project name first, then create the project in an item container. Each call makes a new record.
